decision: Keep static browser scripts with one dependency-free core
why: Preserve static serving and make URL, geometry, and gesture behavior executable in Node

decision: Keep original query precedence and preserve incoming seconds
why: Existing URL parsing accepts browser Date strings and serializes local minutes only after a user search

decision: Leave all changes uncommitted after the first failed git add
why: The user explicitly prohibited workarounds for read-only .git

decision: Own vertical content movement with pointers and preserve native horizontal gestures
why: Continuous scroll-to-sheet handoff cannot reclaim a browser-owned pointer stream

decision: Use offline application fixtures and report missing browser evidence
why: Playwright absent; Firefox startup denied by sandbox; shell DNS unavailable

decision: Scale track time to route duration and interpolate elapsed selection
why: Departure and arrival selections must hit the actual route endpoints

decision: Save only successful trip inputs and handle denied writes visibly
why: Re-runs need fresh forecasts; blocked storage must not break route planning
